title: Open CDLM: A Benchmark and Library for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable comparisons of continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) require evaluating both model fit and the distribution of generated text. Two common practices leave this goal only partially addressed. Likelihood-based evaluation often reports a variational upper bound on discrete negative log-likelihood, whose slack can confound comparisons. Generated-sample-based evaluation commonly combines generative perplexity with within-sequence unigram entropy; both scores can remain favorable even when a sampler produces the same text on every draw. We introduce \textbf{Open CDLM}, a benchmark for evaluating CDLMs and their samplers, and describe the design of an accompanying open-source library to support reproducible comparisons. For likelihood-based evaluation, we clarify which comparisons of model fit are supported by reported perplexity bounds and how those conclusions depend on the evaluation procedure. translated_abstract: 对连续扩散语言模型（CDLM）进行可靠比较，需要同时评估模型拟合优度和生成文本的分布。然而两种常见做法仅能部分实现这一目标：基于似然的评估通常报告离散负对数似然的变分上界，其松弛量可能混淆比较结果；基于生成样本的评估通常将生成困惑度与序列内一元词熵相结合，但即使采样器每次抽取都生成相同的文本，这两个分数仍可能表现良好。我们提出了 Open CDLM——一个用于评估 CDLM 及其采样器的基准测试，并描述了配套开源库的设计，以支持可复现的比较。对于基于似然的评估，我们阐明了所报告的困惑度上界能够支持哪些模型拟合优度比较，以及这些结论如何依赖于评估流程；对于基于样本的评估，我们（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 Open CDLM，一个用于评估连续扩散语言模型及其采样器的基准测试和开源库，旨在解决现有评估方法中变分上界松弛导致比较混淆、以及采样多样性度量无法有效识别重复生成的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Open CDLM, a benchmark and open-source library for evaluating continuous diffusion language models and their samplers, addressing how variational bound slack confounds likelihood-based comparisons and how existing sample-based metrics fail to detect degenerate samplers.
